props.name: value
props.description: Controlled number, expiry and CVC, as digits.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the digits and what they add up to.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the whole control invalid, on top of its own per-field checks.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Put on the card-number input, so a Field label points at it.

props.name: 'aria-describedby'
props.description: Forwarded to each input. Field sets it to its hint or error.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference date for the expiry check. Defaults to now.
